For claim c1:
Wikipedia, "Chandrayaan programme", The Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed on the Moon on August 23, 2023, making India the first nation to successfully land a spacecraft in the lunar south pole region, and the fourth country to land on the Moon after the Soviet Union, the United States, and China. [1] The lander, Vikram, successfully soft-landed in the lunar south pole region, achieving humanity's first soft landing in that area. [1]

Wikipedia, "Chandrayaan-3", Chandrayaan-3 touched down near the lunar south pole, at 69°S, on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC). [2] The mission consists of Vikram, a lunar lander, and Pragyan, a lunar rover. [2]

PBS, "India becomes only the 4th country to successfully land a spacecraft on the moon", Published August 23, 2023. India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, becoming the first country to touch down near the little-explored south pole region. [3] This achievement makes India the fourth country to achieve a moon landing, joining the United States, the Soviet Union, and China. [3]

VOA, "India Becomes First Nation to Land Craft on Moon's South Pole", Published August 23, 2023. India successfully placed a lander in the moon's southern polar region on August 23, 2023, making history as the first country to touch down on an uncharted part of the lunar surface. [4] While the United States, Russia, and China have landed around the moon's equator, no country had previously made a soft landing on the more challenging rough terrain of the south pole. [4]

The Guardian, "India lands spacecraft near south pole of moon in historic first", Published August 22, 2023. India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon, with the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft's Vikram lander touching down shortly after 6 pm (1230 BST) near the lunar south pole. [5] This historic moment marked a world first for any space program. [5]

Astronomy.com, "India makes history with its first Moon landing", Published August 24, 2023. On August 23, 2023, the Indian Space Research Organization's (ISRO) Chandrayaan-3 mission landed near the Moon's south pole. [6] India is the first country to land on the Moon since 2020 and joins the U.S., Russia, and China as lunar visitors. [6]
